item_ostrun_tablet.name: stone tablet
item_ostrun_tablet.description: A slab of black stone, set upright, cut with plain square letters. They read: "For the heir who comes after me. Maldrath's keep is ringed by water no ship will cross. Three things will open the way: the sunstones, which the first king laid beneath his own castle; the cloudcaller's staff, which a hermit in the frost-hollow to the north-east gives to anyone who brings him the moon harp; and my signet, which I lost in the mire to the south. Bring all three to the last sage in the sunken hollow, and he will make of them a prism. Then walk across the rainbow."

item_barrow_notice.name: weathered stone
item_barrow_notice.description: A leaning stone at the barrow's mouth, cut with a few worn words: "Harrow lies below, and what he guarded with him."
